title: Desk-bound session risk scoping under Enforce (arch item J)
description: A desk-bound trader session resolves its effective_principal and narrows it to its desk (narrow_to_desk), so under the Enforce posture it sees ONLY its desk's risk: an out-of-desk query returns strictly fewer positions than a grant-all principal. The structural narrowing seam is landed; the end-to-end exercise through a wire client is the deferred tail. This is the frozen-contract acceptance for the deliverable 'desk-session-risk-scoping'.

assertions.statement: narrow_to_desk(base: Principal, desk_value: u64) -> Principal is the single desk-narrowing transform applied to a desk-bound session: a grant-all base becomes one Desk-dimension grant, a scoped base has every grant ANDed with the desk rule, and denies are preserved.
RiskEdge::effective_principal resolves the caller's effective Principal — the base that narrow_to_desk is applied to — from the session / grant context.
effective_desk_filter derives the desk-visibility filter from the effective desk so a desk-bound risk query is narrowed to that desk's positions.

Under the Enforce posture a desk-bound session sees strictly fewer positions than a grant-all principal, and an out-of-desk query returns fewer positions than grant-all — exercised end-to-end through a wire client. (Forward target — the wire-client e2e is the deferred tail.)
